name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR

usb_ports.J1: Dedicated 48 V / 5 A USB-C PD 3.1 EPR POWER sink; no USB data
usb_ports.J10: USB 2.0 DATA plus independent, current-limited logic power; two 5.1k CC Rd; no PD negotiation and no connection to VMOTOR

mechanical.outline: TMCM-1180 V1.1 stepped perimeter with four 5.9 mm concave corner arcs

encoder.validation: Optional bottom-side U18 and both bypass capacitors are DNP. Sensor center matches the ordered motor axis at (0,0). The single-shaft motor has no documented rear rotating-shaft interface; no magnet/holder or working gap is qualified.

motor_assembly.selected_motor: STEPPERONLINE 34HS31-6004S1; user confirmed Amazon ASIN B091C83HWF on 2026-10-11
motor_assembly.status: Exact ordered-motor CAD in an alignment preview; unsupported adapter/posts/fasteners removed. Existing four PCB holes unchanged. Rear thread/depth, secure mounting and encoder attachment remain unverified.

fabrication.via_in_pad: filled and capped for CSD19534 thermal pads

rated_targets.motor_current_note: 5.5 A RMS remains the existing board design screen only, not a qualified setting for this motor; motion firmware remains locked.

logic_power.U22: VMOTOR -> V3V3_MOTOR -> U24 -> board V3V3 (brake backup)
logic_power.motor_power: J1 only; USB DATA cannot energize VMOTOR
logic_power.reverse_blocking: Two cascaded status-interlocked LM66100 pairs; DATA and PD VBUS are never connected
logic_power.usb_default_budget: Startup before enumeration and USB suspend current must be measured and qualified; the current limiter is overload protection, not a USB enumeration policy
logic_power.usb_data_power: USB DATA alone powers MCU setup/diagnostics. Flash, encoder and sensors require board V3V3. CDC advertises a bus-powered 500 mA configuration.
logic_power.U25: USB_DATA_VBUS -> TPS2553 U28 -> TLV75533 U25 -> V3V3_USB
logic_power.selection: U26/U27 + R112: status-interlocked OR of board V3V3 and V3V3_USB into V3V3_MCU
logic_power.board_presence: R119/R120 10k/10k divider into STM32 PB1; 2.9–3.6 V qualified for 20 ms before peripheral access. PD IRQ removed; status remains polled.
logic_power.suspend: USB suspend disarms, invalidates telemetry, ends I2C, turns status low and enters STOP0. RTC/LSI wakes main every nominal 50 ms to service the 250 ms IWDG and sample DATA VBUS; USB resume/reset wakes normally. Physical current/timing validation remains open.
logic_power.gpio_backfeed: Chip selects use open-drain release into board-domain pullups; no high drive into unpowered peripherals. Peripheral inputs and I2C pins become analog/high impedance when board power is absent or USB suspended.

temperature.validation: Board temperature only; MOSFET junction correlation and thresholds require load testing

phase_current.validation: Instantaneous diagnostics; nominal VDDA and offset require calibration. Not a short-circuit trip or an RMS estimate.

indicators.supply: PD_3V3, shared with the PD_SCL/PD_SDA pull-ups; TCA9538 SCL/SDA may not exceed VCC
indicators.reset: STATUS_GPIO (PC13), 10k pulldown; assert low on reset, rail loss, USB suspend or indicator bus failure

ports.P3: Buzzer MOSFET gate through 1k; 100k gate pulldown

indicators.power_indicator: D17 red LED + 4.7k from board V3V3; does not indicate USB-only MCU power
indicators.alarm: FUET-9650B-3V active buzzer; AO3400A low-side switch; BAV21W flyback diode

firmware_states.amber: waiting for qualified telemetry/power after qualification
firmware_states.green: qualified supply/telemetry; RUN reported separately over USB
firmware_states.red: latched motor fault, reported driver fault or overtemperature; 200 ms alarm every 2 s

indicators.budget_status: design allocation, not measured; buzzer max 30 mA specified at 3 V only, allow 60 mA at board-rail extremes pending qualification
indicators.gate_drive: R126 1k limits charging to <3.7 mA at 3.6 V; R127 100k pulls Q26 gate low when expander is reset
indicators.qualification: Current, sound, brightness, reset silence and source transitions require first-article measurements

motor_harness.splice: TE 320559, one 0.75 mm² motor conductor to one 16 AWG pigtail per splice; four splices
motor_harness.connection_status: Defined harness; not supplied with PCB assembly. Harness maker must confirm crimp/insulation dimensions and provide continuity/pull-test records.
motor_harness.current_note: JST 10 A applies to the standard header with 16 AWG termination, not directly to the motor factory 0.75 mm² wire. Motor current is still governed by its qualification; no 10 A motor rating is implied.

pd_programming.switch: U36 SN74LVC2G66DCUR opens both I2Cc wires when TP_PD_ISO is grounded
pd_programming.target_power: fixed 5 V supplied through J1; no EPR negotiation during fixture programming
pd_programming.programmer: 3.3 V open-drain, ground first, VCC output disabled; TP_PD_VREF is sense only
pd_programming.programming_status: fixture access designed; TI image, fixture acceptance and readback/boot qualification pending

local_control.start_stop: SW2, PC6 / USER_BUTTON_N, active-low with R133 10k pullup to V3V3_MCU
local_control.motion_mode: TMC5160 internal SPI ramp; SD_MODE low; unused U7 pins 17,18,23,24,25 grounded
local_control.qualification: Motion inhibited until TI configuration and powered bridge validation exist
local_control.external_command_interfaces: None; J7 and STEP/DIR/ENABLE/home/limit conditioning removed
local_control.protection: U10/U11/U33 and DRV_EN_N pullup retained; Q14 emitter grounded after removal of external-enable transistor Q15
